title: Incremental equations in curvature-dependent surface elasticity
summary: We develop a general incremental framework for hyperelastic solids whose surfaces exhibit both stretch-dependent and curvature-dependent elastic behavior. Building upon a variational formulation of curvature-dependent surface elasticity, we derive compact governing equations expressed in a coordinate-free Lagrangian setting that remain valid for arbitrary geometries.
